findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit SSE header may be stored without a bucket-enforced encryption setting.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not provide encryption for objects stored in the bucket.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not ensure that artifact objects are encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. The private ACL and versioning setting do not enforce encryption for stored runbooks.
The object upload does not specify server-side encryption, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The vendor roster may therefore be uploaded without encryption at rest.
